text:
Marta: Quick coordination thread  we finished the Lighthouse customer interview yesterday. goal: blog + transcript + short social clips. embargo target 2026-04-14. who can own transcript + vendor handoff?
Dennis: I got this  will run transcription and diarization. need final wav and an S3 path to deposit.
Marta: uploaded raw: s3://redwood-marketing/lighthouse/audio/lighthouse_interview_2026-03-18.wav
Anjali: I can manage localization slots. LingoWorks confirmed availability for DE/FR/JP on 03/22. will need clean transcript with timecodes and simple glossary of product terms.
Tom: please add speaker labels (Customer / Host) so we can pull quotes easily. also can we flag moments for a 60s highlight?
Dennis: starting job now. will produce:
- transcript.raw.v1.txt (with timecodes)
- transcript.clean.v1.txt (remove ums/ahs)
- transcript.diarized.v1.txt (speaker labels)
- transcript.srt
Marta: perfect. we need two short customer quotes cleared by legal before publish. Maya can you advise on phrasing?
Maya (Legal): yes. send candidate quotes as bullets. if metrics are stated (e.g., % reduction, months), attach source (dashboard screenshot) or use conservative wording. review turnaround ~48h.
Marta: draft quotes (first pass):
- "Lighthouse reduced our inference cost by about 50% within two months."
- "Switching to Redwood made latency consistent across regions."
Maya (Legal): suggestion  replace "about 50%" with "roughly 50%" or provide the KPI snapshot. also ask customer to confirm exact wording.
Anjali: noted for localization: avoid colloquialisms in the canonical quote so translations are natural. will send both neutral and localized variants.
PublishBot: Transcription complete  files uploaded to s3://redwood-marketing/lighthouse/deliverables/ at 2026-03-18T16:02:15Z :white_check_mark:
Dennis: uploaded diarized transcript and srt. added speaker tags and timecodes. posted deliverables to the folder and pinged Marta.
Marta: Anjali please send the two quote options to the customer for signoff, include exact punctuation and capitalization. include a conservative fallback. deadline: 2026-03-20 EOD.
Anjali: emailed customer and included localized-friendly phrasing + brand glossary. asked for signoff by 03/20.
LingoWorks: confirmed localization slot 03/22. will expect final transcript and glossary by morning of 03/22.
Tom: timeline check  if we get quotes by 03/20 and legal clears by 03/22 we can hit 04/14 embargo for blog + clips. adding a 2-day buffer for CMS scheduling.
Maya (Legal): customer approved the conservative quote this morning. I ran a redline  minor punctuation edits. legal signoff complete.
Marta: great. locking embargo 2026-04-14. next: Dennis please produce a 60s captioned highlight (highlight_60s.mp4) and add to deliverables.
Dennis: will cut the 60s clip from timestamps 00:02:14-00:03:14 and burn in captions from the srt. will upload as lighthouse_highlight_60s.mp4.
PublishBot: Asset lighthouse_highlight_60s.mp4 uploaded to s3://redwood-marketing/lighthouse/deliverables/ at 2026-03-19T09:12:03Z
Marta: Ill draft the launch brief and hero copy once quotes are inserted. will post preview in #marketing for feedback.
Tom: also requesting a short benchmark sidebar for the blog showing latency & cost before/after (anonymized). Dennis/Maya, can we pull a dashboard screenshot with IDs masked?
Maya (Legal): yes  we can mask customer IDs. ensure metrics are rounded and accompanied by note that results may vary.
Dennis: pulled dashboard snapshot and masked IDs per Maya. uploaded to the deliverables folder as dashboard_masked.png.
Marta: thanks all. summary actions: Dennis  finalize assets + 60s clip; Anjali  confirm localization + customer quote signoff; Maya  final legal redline; Tom  prepare benchmark sidebar. aiming for approvals by 03/22 to keep embargo.
Dennis: all deliverables posted.
Marta: excellent  closing thread. will @channel with the launch brief when ready. :tada:
